_comment: Sample transcript for `clip_lab selftest`. A ~23 min Yasuo game with a running gag ('I'll hit a Q eventually') that pays off on a pentakill. Times are seconds. Word timestamps are included on a few segments to show the real shape; whisper produces this automatically.

segments.text: Yo yo yo what's up chat, we are locking in Yasuo again, I know, I know.
Listen, today is the day the mechanics finally show up. I can feel it.
Okay watch this, I swear I'm gonna hit a Q eventually, just watch, it's coming.
Missed. Okay that one doesn't count, the minion moved.
They're diving me, they're diving me — okay okay stay calm, wait for it.
There it is! First blood! I actually hit the Q, did you see that, chat?!
Okay I'm gonna flash over the wall and — no. NO. Why is there a wall there?! Who put that there?!
I flashed directly into the wall. Straight into it. That's a me problem, that's on me.
Alright we're scaling, we're scaling, just farm it up, don't int, do not int.
Double kill! Okay okay the wind wall carried, the wind wall is so good.
They're all on me, I'm dead, I'm dead, I'm so dead, there's three of them.
Wait. WAIT. What?! Triple kill! How did I live that, how am I alive right now?!
That's the outplay of the year, clip that, somebody clip that right now.
And THAT is a clean Q. See? See, I told you. I told you I'd hit the Q eventually.
Two hours in but we got there. Growth. That's called growth, chat.
Dragon's up, everybody group, we take this and we're basically winning.
Baron! We got Baron, nobody's contesting, this game is ours, end it, end it.
Okay they're grouping mid for the last fight, this is it, this is for the game.
I'm going in. I don't care. Windwall's up, ult's up, let's go, all of them.
Double — triple — QUADRA — PENTAKILL! PENTAKILL! I hit all of them! I HIT ALL OF THEM!
From the guy who couldn't hit a single Q at minute one. We did it. GG. GG chat.
